frontend_strategy: Use Cloudflare Pages for hosting the static SPA from project/static/. Pages provides automatic CDN distribution, instant cache purging, unlimited bandwidth on all plans, and automatic HTTPS via Cloudflare's SSL. The frontend is a vanilla JS SPA (index.html 55KB, app.js 446KB, style.css 58KB, plus admin.html, hitl.html, i18n.js, sw.js, voice_engine.js, v3_tokens.css, manifest.json, favicon.*, charts/ dir with SVG files) that calls /api/v1/*, /api/v2/*, /api/v3/*, /admin/*, /hitl/*, /metrics, /health, /docs, /openapi.json. Cloudflare Pages is preferable to Workers for hosting static assets because it serves from edge nodes globally with automatic cache invalidation, has a simpler deployment model (git integration or direct upload), and lower latency for static file delivery. The Pages project should be configured with a custom domain pointing to horoconsultant.yourdomain.com. A _worker.js or functions/ directory in the Pages project handles the API proxy routes, while everything else falls back to static file serving from the [site] bucket.
workers_config: A Cloudflare Pages Functions (Workers) setup using a single _worker.js entry point at the root of the Pages project directory (or under functions/). The worker intercepts requests matching /api/v1/*, /api/v2/*, /api/v3/*, /admin/*, /hitl/*, /metrics, /health, /docs, /openapi.json and proxies them to https://pphothidaen-horoconsultant-core-backend.hf.space. The worker replicates the existing Vercel gateway logic from api/index.js: path validation against an allowlist, method enforcement (GET for public reads, POST/PUT/DELETE for admin), bearer token requirement for privileged paths, CORS policy enforcement via an origin allowlist, request body size limits (2MB cap), 8-30s timeout handling, and safe error forwarding with correlation IDs. Static assets are served directly from Pages without worker involvement (Pages handles the [site] bucket before worker invocation). The environment variable HF_BACKEND_URL should be set in Cloudflare Pages environment variables (production/preview). CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS can also be configured via Pages env vars. The worker uses the standard fetch() API to forward requests, sets upstream headers (accept, authorization, content-type, if-none-match, user-agent, x-request-id), and returns upstream response bodies transparently. For OPTIONS preflight, the worker returns 204 with appropriate CORS headers. Error responses follow the same shape as the Vercel gateway: { status, code, detail, correlation_id }.
wrangler_toml:
# wrangler.toml for HoroConsultant Cloudflare Pages + Worker deployment

# Required: Pages project name (used in wrangler pages publish)
name = "horoconsultant-pages"

# Cloudflare account ID (from dash.cloudflare.com → Workers & Pages → Account ID)
account_id = "YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID_HERE"

# Pages build configuration
pages_build_output_dir = "project/static"

# Compatibility date determines available Workers runtime APIs
compatibility_date = "2025-01-15"

# Optional: compatibility flags for newer runtime features
# compatibility_flags = ["nodejs_compat"]

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Static asset binding — serves files from project/static/ (the [site] bucket)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[site]
bucket = "./project/static"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables — non-secret configuration. Secrets use `wrangler secret put`.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[vars]
BACKEND_BASE_URL = "https://pphothidaen-horoconsultant-core-backend.hf.space"
BACKEND_TIMEOUT_MS = "15000"
CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = "https://horoconsultant.yourdomain.com"
SERVICE_NAME = "horoconsultant-gateway"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Environment: production
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[env.production]
vars = { BACKEND_BASE_URL = "https://pphothidaen-horoconsultant-core-backend.hf.space", BACKEND_TIMEOUT_MS = "15000", CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = "https://horoconsultant.yourdomain.com", SERVICE_NAME = "horoconsultant-gateway-prod" }

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Environment: staging (preview deploys)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[env.staging]
vars = { BACKEND_BASE_URL = "https://pphothidaen-horoconsultant-core-backend.hf.space", BACKEND_TIMEOUT_MS = "30000", CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = "https://staging.horoconsultant.yourdomain.com", SERVICE_NAME = "horoconsultant-gateway-staging" }

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Workers Logs — real-time observability via `wrangler tail`
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[observability]
enabled = true

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# KV namespace example (if caching proxy responses)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# [[kv_bindings]]
# binding = "CACHE"
# id = "YOUR_KV_NAMESPACE_ID"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# R2 binding example (if serving generated artifacts)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# [[r2_buckets]]
# binding = "ARTIFACTS"
# bucket_name = "horoconsultant-artifacts"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# D1 binding example (if session/state storage needed)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# [[d1_databases]]
# binding = "DB"
# database_id = "YOUR_DATABASE_ID"
migration_notes: Migration from Vercel Pages Functions requires the following structural changes: (1) Move static assets into a single deploy directory (project/static/) — currently they are scattered; create a _worker.js file at the project root of that directory to handle API proxy routes. (2) Replace Node.js-specific patterns (Buffer.from, res.status().json, req.headers as plain object) with Web Fetch API equivalents (Response.json(), new Headers(), Response constructor with init status/headers). The Vercel gateway uses a two-module split (api/index.js + api/gateway.js); for Cloudflare, consolidate into a single _worker.js with an onRequest handler or use Pages Functions convention (functions/_middleware.ts or a catch-all route). (3) CORS logic in api/gateway.js uses res.setHeader with getHeader — map to new Response() construction with headers. (4) Vercel-specific env vars (VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA, VERCEL_BACKEND_TIMEOUT_MS) should be replaced with Cloudflare Pages env vars (CF_PAGES_COMMIT_SHA or custom vars). (5) Replace the path param convention (/api/index?path=/api/v1/...) with direct URL routing in the worker — Cloudflare Pages Functions use path-based routing where /api/v1/calculate is a direct match. (6) Vercel's vercel.json rewrites are not needed; Pages _worker.js serves static files from the [site] bucket by default and intercepts matched routes. (7) Add a _redirects or _headers file at static root for SPA routing (/* /index.html 200) and security headers. (8) Service workers (sw.js) need their scope updated if they were registered relative to /api paths. (9) The charts/ directory contains SVG files — ensure MIME types are correct (Pages auto-detects, but verify via _headers). (10) For production hardening, add Turnstile to admin/auth endpoints, configure WAF rules for /admin/* path, and use Workers Logs for observability. (11) Deploy via `wrangler pages deploy project/static --project-name=horoconsultant-pages` or connect to Cloudflare's git integration for automatic deploys on push.
